name: Dawning Isles
summary: Along Silverpine Forest’s eastern edge, the Dawning Isles rise from Lordamere Lake beneath the growing numbers of Vile Fin murlocs. The Plague of Undeath blighted their shores, leaving the islets rotting.

sections.title: Blight on the Lake
sections.body:
The Vile Fin murlocs hold the Dawning Isles. Before the Third War, these islets rested in Lordamere Lake’s calm, clear waters. Then the Plague of Undeath swept across Lordaeron, and corruption spread through the shallows. The vegetation turned pallid and rotting, and the islands lost their former peace.

Now the Vile Fin murlocs hold the muddy shores and tangled brush. They defend their growing colonies against anyone who tries to cross the lake.

sections.title: A Murloc Stronghold
sections.body: Bog beasts once prowled the blighted Dawning Isles alongside the murlocs. Since the bog beasts vanished, the Vile Fin population has swelled. The murlocs now control the isles outright, making this chain of islets their stronghold on Lordamere Lake.

faq.q: Where are the Dawning Isles located?
faq.answer: The Dawning Isles rise from Lordamere Lake along Silverpine Forest’s eastern boundary, just west of the Ruins of Lordaeron.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Dawning Isles?
faq.answer: The Vile Fin tribe of murlocs thrives along the corrupted shores. Bog beasts once prowled the islets too, but they have largely vanished as the murloc population has grown.

faq.q: Why are the trees and shores rotting here?
faq.answer: The Plague of Undeath tainted the Dawning Isles as it swept across Lordaeron during the Third War. The water and soil absorbed the blight, poisoning the vegetation and leaving the islets murky, sickly, and decayed.

angles.text: The Dawning Isles lie on Lordamere Lake, within sight of the Undercity’s western approaches. The Vile Fin murlocs that hold them grow more numerous each year.
The Dawning Isles show how far the Scourge’s corruption reached into Lordaeron’s scenic waters.
